title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #8 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #8 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How can children with speech difficulties join prayers at assembly? (1 mark)
   A. They must not attend
   B. By shouting
   C. By leaving
   D. By humming or listening

2. Which prayer starts with the words Twameva mata cha pita twameva? (1 mark)
   A. Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva
   B. Gayatri Mantra
   C. Om Namah Shivaya
   D. Saraswati Vandana

3. Which is a typical feature of Mandirs? (1 mark)
   A. A roaring engine
   B. A bell rung gently on arrival
   C. A kitchen garden
   D. A water tank

4. What should you do with your shoes before entering a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. Throw them
   B. Remove them
   C. Carry them inside
   D. Wear them

5. What should you do before taking photographs in a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. Use flash
   B. Take at once
   C. Photograph the murti closely
   D. Ask permission

6. What does Kirat Karni mean? (1 mark)
   A. Painting
   B. Earning by honest work
   C. Fasting
   D. Travelling

7. You find Ksh 100 on the school field. What shows integrity? (1 mark)
   A. Spend it on sweets
   B. Give it to the teacher so it can be returned
   C. Give it away
   D. Keep it quietly

8. Which of these is honest saving? (1 mark)
   A. Taking from another's savings
   B. Saving your own money and not taking from others
   C. Borrowing secretly
   D. Hiding others' money

9. The shopkeeper gives you Ksh 100 in change but you should get Ksh 70. What is the extra amount? (1 mark)
   A. Ksh 170
   B. Ksh 100
   C. Ksh 70
   D. Ksh 30

10. Which is a benefit of integrity? (1 mark)
   A. People trust us
   B. People avoid us
   C. We are always angry
   D. We feel afraid

11. Which action during the journey is wrong? (1 mark)
   A. Speaking quietly
   B. Putting hands out of the window
   C. Sitting still
   D. Keeping the aisle clear

12. Which is honest behaviour with technology? (1 mark)
   A. Asking permission before using a device
   B. Sharing your personal details with strangers
   C. Copying someone's work
   D. Sending unkind messages

13. What does Sadachaar mean? (1 mark)
   A. Daily prayer
   B. A festival
   C. A holy river
   D. Good conduct

14. What does asana mean? (1 mark)
   A. A song
   B. A prayer
   C. A posture or seat
   D. A river

15. Why is yoga best done with an expert? (1 mark)
   A. To be noisy
   B. To avoid strain from wrong posture
   C. So no one else can join
   D. To finish faster

16. Which is a mistake in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Holding the breath for too long
   B. Breathing slowly
   C. Working with a teacher
   D. Stopping if unwell

17. In Sasankasana, where do your arms go at the end? (1 mark)
   A. On your head
   B. Stretched forward on the floor
   C. In the air
   D. Behind your back

18. What should you do if your knees hurt in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. Stop and come out of the pose
   B. Ignore it
   C. Push harder
   D. Stay for an hour

19. What does the word yoga mean? (1 mark)
   A. To sleep
   B. To run
   C. To eat
   D. To join or unite

20. How do you sit in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. Lie down
   B. Kneel and sit on your heels
   C. Stand on your hands
   D. Sit cross-legged

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain how you can show integrity when using the internet. (3 marks)

22. Write a short paragraph on why honesty is the best policy. (5 marks)

23. List three things you should do before starting yoga. (3 marks)

24. Describe how to do Sasankasana. (4 marks)

25. State three rules of good behaviour when visiting a Mandir. (3 marks)

26. Why should a passenger wait for the vehicle to stop before getting off? (2 marks)

27. Why should we breathe slowly during asanas? (2 marks)

28. Describe the four things a person may do at a Mandir and what each shows. (4 marks)

29. Explain four things a passenger should do when alighting. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #8 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — By humming or listening
   Everyone can take part in their own way.

2. A — Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva
   It begins with these words.

3. B — A bell rung gently on arrival
   The bell announces arrival.

4. B — Remove them
   Shoes are removed to keep it clean and show respect.

5. D — Ask permission
   Always ask first.

6. B — Earning by honest work
   Kirat Karni is honest labour.

7. B — Give it to the teacher so it can be returned
   A lost note belongs to its owner.

8. B — Saving your own money and not taking from others
   Honest saving respects others.

9. D — Ksh 30
   100 minus 70 is 30.

10. A — People trust us
   Honest people are trusted.

11. B — Putting hands out of the window
   Hands can be hurt.

12. A — Asking permission before using a device
   Permission is part of responsible use.

13. D — Good conduct
   Sadachaar is the way a good person behaves.

14. C — A posture or seat
   An asana is a posture.

15. B — To avoid strain from wrong posture
   Experts correct mistakes.

16. A — Holding the breath for too long
   Never force the breath.

17. B — Stretched forward on the floor
   Arms are stretched forward.

18. A — Stop and come out of the pose
   Do not force the body.

19. D — To join or unite
   Yoga joins body, breath and mind.

20. B — Kneel and sit on your heels
   You sit on your heels.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ask permission before using a device, do not copy another's work, do not send unkind or untrue messages, and keep personal details private (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

22. (5 marks)
   Answer: An honest person is trusted, feels calm, makes friends, keeps a good name and helps the community. A liar loses trust. Examples such as returning lost money or not cheating support the paragraph.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the topic, 2 marks for reasons, 1 mark for an example, 1 mark for a clear conclusion.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wear loose clothes, prepare a mat, have an empty stomach, find a quiet place, meet with a teacher (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: Start in Vajra Asana, breathe in and raise the arms, breathe out and bend forward, rest the forehead on the mat with arms stretched forward, breathe calmly and come up slowly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four correct steps.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Remove shoes, dress modestly, speak softly, switch off phones, do not touch the murti, ask before taking photographs (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: Moving while the vehicle is moving can cause falls and accidents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for danger, 1 mark for safety.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: It keeps us calm and helps the body relax.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Darshan shows respect, aarti offers light, prasad shows blessing and sharing, bhajans show love in song.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

29. (4 marks)
   Answer: Wait for the vehicle to stop, take belongings, get off one at a time, look out for traffic, thank the driver (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
